title: AF Corse confirms two-car Ferrari 499P Hypercar effort for Asian Le Mans Series
extract: AF Corse will field two Ferrari 499P Hypercars in the 2026/27 Asian Le Mans Series, becoming the first team to confirm a Hypercar entry for the new championship.

title: Ford GT (2017-2023) review: Ford's most modern Ferrari-beater
extract: Evo revisits the second-generation Ford GT, examining the road car's Le Mans-derived engineering, dramatic performance and compromises away from the circuit.

title: A new track for half the field: Six Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia talking points
extract: RaceFans previews Formula 1's return to Sepang, looking at the unfamiliar circuit for much of the field and the technical and competitive questions it creates.

title: Two-times Indianapolis 500 winner Gordon Johncock dies aged 90
extract: Gordon Johncock, a two-time Indianapolis 500 winner and 1976 USAC National Champion, has died aged 90, closing the career of one of American open-wheel racing's notable champions.

title: Synopsys and OpenAI strike deal to develop AI model for chip design work
extract: Synopsys and OpenAI are developing GPT-Synopsys, a model trained to use chip-design software and help engineers navigate circuit and transistor-layout optimisation while traditional tools retain final verification.

title: Canonical begins pushing Resolute Raccoon
extract: Canonical has begun offering Ubuntu 26.04.1 to Ubuntu 24.04 users, marking the point release at which the normal LTS upgrade path starts to open.

title: OpenClaw slips on a suit to evade widespread business bans
extract: Red Hat, Nvidia, OpenAI and others are working on an enterprise edition of OpenClaw, positioning the agent platform as a controlled, Kubernetes-like environment for business deployments.

title: Castlevania AGA reaches version 1.0 on Commodore Amiga
extract: Dante Retro Dev's fan-made Castlevania AGA has reached version 1.0, delivering a complete reimagining of the 1986 game for Amiga AGA machines with new content, polish and a printable manual.

title: The C64 and ZX Spectrum handhelds delayed to April 2027
extract: Retro Games Ltd and Blaze have delayed their clamshell C64 and ZX Spectrum handhelds from October 2026 to April 22, 2027 after production quality issues were found during manufacturing.

title: VOID LANCER is a technically ambitious new C64 shoot-'em-up
extract: Snow-G's new C64 shooter is written from scratch in 6502 assembly and uses advanced sprite multiplexing, smooth scrolling, procedural graphics and a fast-loading system to push the eight-bit machine.

title: David Bowie: You're Not Alone to open at Brighton Dome
extract: A 360-degree David Bowie experience built from rare performance footage, photography, drawings, lyrics, notes and audio recordings will have a limited 2027 run at Brighton Dome.

title: David Bowie's 1. Outside at 31
extract: A retrospective marks the 31st anniversary of David Bowie's 1. Outside, revisiting the album and highlighting new music created around the anniversary.

title: Rolex charity auction raises nearly $50 million
extract: Four unique Rolex Daytona watches made for Rolex's first charity auction raised a combined £37.3 million, with proceeds benefiting the Federer Foundation and Re:wild.

title: Breitling and Aston Martin present Top Time Tribute to the DB5
extract: Breitling and Aston Martin have created three limited editions of the Top Time B01 Chronograph 41 inspired by the design and history of the Aston Martin DB5.

title: Missouri Williams and China Miéville among writers on Goldsmiths shortlist
extract: The 2026 Goldsmiths Prize shortlist includes China Miéville's 1,200-page paranormal novel The Rouse alongside five other books recognised for pushing at the boundaries of the novel form.

title: Cherise Saywell wins BBC National Short Story Award
extract: Cherise Saywell has won the 2026 BBC National Short Story Award for Ditto, a story about a child confronting domestic violence, recognised by judges for its emotional precision and control.

title: The 2026 Aldiss Award shortlist
extract: The 2026 Aldiss Award for World Building in speculative fiction has shortlisted five works spanning science fiction, fantasy and other speculative forms.

title: Patrick Radden Keefe's London Falling shortlisted for Baillie Gifford Prize
extract: Patrick Radden Keefe's London Falling is among six books shortlisted for the 2026 Baillie Gifford Prize, alongside works of biography, history and reporting.

title: Stations by Louise Kennedy review: a powerful journey from the Troubles to London
extract: The Guardian reviews Louise Kennedy's new novel Stations, following characters between 1980s Northern Ireland and London in a story shaped by the legacy of the Troubles.

title: Today's 22 new book releases from Min Jin Lee, Hernan Diaz, Ayad Akhtar and more
extract: A September 30 release roundup highlights major new fiction including Min Jin Lee's American Hagwon, Hernan Diaz's Ply and Ayad Akhtar's The Radiance.

title: Jennifer Lawrence joins Zach Cregger's sci-fi thriller The Flood
extract: Jennifer Lawrence will lead Zach Cregger's original science-fiction thriller The Flood, a deep-space story involving a strange signal and an alien artefact that warps time and reality.

title: Paramount gets court green light on Warner Bros deal
extract: A US court has approved the proposed Paramount-Warner Bros acquisition, a major development for the companies behind franchises including Star Trek and other film and television properties.
